title: opensAt carries a non-UTC offset
description: opensAt is 2026-08-15T23:59:59+02:00 — a valid RFC 3339 date-time, so format alone accepts it, but the standard additionally requires UTC with a trailing uppercase 'Z' (pattern Z$). A single timezone representation keeps temporal values lexicographically sortable into chronological order (RFC 3339 §5.1); mixed offsets silently break plain string sorting. Stands in for every date-time field: numeric offsets, the -00:00 unknown-offset convention and lowercase 'z' are all rejected.
